// diagnostic

E0414

Unknown `priv(…)` qualifier, or `priv(package)` on a top-level declaration other than a module

What

Unknown `priv(…)` qualifier, or `priv(package)` on a top-level declaration other than a module

Why

`priv(package)` is the only qualifier, and at a file's top level plain `priv` already keeps a declaration inside its package

Fix

Delete the qualifier: write `priv`, or `priv(package)` on a module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0414: tests/ui/vis_priv_package_top_level.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownPrivQualifier]: A top-level declaration takes plain `priv`, not `priv(package)`
  --> tests/ui/vis_priv_package_top_level.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | priv(package) helper: fn() -> Int { 1 }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: At a file's top level `priv` already keeps a declaration inside its package; only a module takes `priv(package)` there
 Fix: Write `priv`
